rules.roads: Natural Earth 1:10m roads in Europe, sampled every 2 km and snapped to hex-centre links. Class 0: every road Natural Earth marks as an expressway (motorways). Class 1: other major highways at Natural Earth scale rank 6 or less.
rules.rail: Natural Earth 1:10m railroads at scale rank 8 or less, snapped to hex-centre links; tier 0 (main line) is scale rank 6 or less. Natural Earth is map art, not statistics: it holds only part of the real network.
rules.ports: Eurostat “main ports” (over 1 million tonnes a year) handling at least 5 million tonnes of goods, placed at their UN/LOCODE position.
rules.airports: Airports with at least 1 million passengers carried in the latest full year (Eurostat avia_paoa), placed by ICAO code with OurAirports. Hub classes here: large 20M+, medium 8M+, small 3M+, otherwise 1M+.
